body:
**Type:** Bug · **Priority:** P0

## Repository ownership

**Hive Mind implementation:** [link-assistant/hive-mind#3909](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/issues/3909). This Formal AI issue owns its caller/workflow integration and cross-repository acceptance. **Completion is blocked by that Hive Mind implementation.** Work on independent Formal AI changes can proceed in parallel.

## Problem and current evidence

Formal AI's issue workflow now builds current main, but Hive Mind's own issue-created draft path can still run the backend baked into an older image.

The [2026-10-30 Hive draft, run 41081977243/job 124153176671](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/41081977243/job/124153176671), for hive-mind#3863, reported wrapper and serving backend **0.355.15** around 15:41 UTC. [Formal AI v0.355.23](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/releases/tag/v0.355.23) had been published at 04:10:32 UTC that day.

At reviewed Hive source `279ac05609d2a791c184c4f9fe7ee071e40ef6a4`:
- [Dockerfile](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/279ac05609d2a791c184c4f9fe7ee071e40ef6a4/Dockerfile) defaults `FORMAL_AI_VERSION=0.355.15`.
- [formal-ai-draft.mjs](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/279ac05609d2a791c184c4f9fe7ee071e40ef6a4/scripts/formal-ai-draft.mjs) mounts a different binary only when explicitly supplied.
- [formal-ai-draft-image.lib.mjs](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/279ac05609d2a791c184c4f9fe7ee071e40ef6a4/scripts/formal-ai-draft-image.lib.mjs) permits fallback from the exact Hive image to `latest`.

The serving-version probe already exists. The missing guarantee is selection and custody of the intended runtime, not printing another version string. A one-time version bump only postpones the same defect.

## Outcome that unblocks development

Every live issue-created attempt measures the intended current Formal AI and Hive implementation. Historical replays remain pinned and explicitly historical.

## Implementation steps

1. Define a shared attempt identity containing Formal AI source SHA, Hive source SHA, package versions, binary digest, image digest, client/adapter versions and selection timestamp.
2. Resolve current sources once at live-attempt admission. Obtain authenticated artifacts for those exact sources, or build once when absent. Reuse the existing Formal AI caller-binary mount protocol and provenance checks.
3. Verify the actual process and serving endpoint match the selected artifacts before accepting work. Version equality alone is insufficient when different source commits share a version.
4. Apply this contract to both repositories' issue-open paths. Track the cross-repository change here and link the corresponding Hive PR; a Formal AI-only change cannot close the integration requirement.
5. Eliminate silent fallback to an unqualified image/backend. Unavailable artifacts produce a typed infrastructure/deferred outcome, preserving evidence and zero capability credit.
6. Distinguish live current-source evaluation, published-release qualification, and historical pinned replay in receipts and dashboards.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Build a Hive image, advance Formal AI, then open a new issue: the next live draft runs the newly selected Formal AI source without rebuilding the entire Hive base merely to update its backend.
- [ ] Compare selected source, authenticated binary/image identity and actual serving identity; mismatches are rejected before task effects.
- [ ] Missing exact images/artifacts cannot silently become `latest`.
- [ ] Current-source selection happens once per attempt and survives retries; a new source selection creates a new attempt identity.
- [ ] Both repositories demonstrate the same contract in issue-created workflows.
- [ ] Historical replay fixtures remain reproducible and cannot be reported as current-source success.
- [ ] Fast tests cover source drift and stale/missing artifact cases; one hosted attempt verifies the complete integration.

Related: #1210, #1162, #1364; Hive #2207/#2208 address older lifecycle/version-reporting concerns, which should not be reimplemented.

## Dependency contract

**Blocked by:** link-assistant/hive-mind#3909 for cross-repository completion.

**Blocks:** #1162.

Related umbrella issues provide context; their entire broader scope is not an implicit prerequisite.

comments.body: Formal AI through Hive Mind did not produce a verified new draft PR in this attempt. [Complete session evidence](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/actions/runs/41191428282/artifacts/13039776619). [Workflow run and build/attempt logs](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/actions/runs/41191428282). No draft was hand-fixed or merged.

Hive Mind side: https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/3912 (for link-assistant/hive-mind#3909).

**Contract.** Each issue-created draft is admitted once, by a `select` job, as an immutable attempt identity (`hive-mind/formal-ai-draft-attempt-identity/v1`). The identity records:

- the Formal AI source SHA and version, and the binary source (`release` whose native receipt names that exact commit, a fresh `build`, a `caller` binary, or `image-baked` for historical replay only);
- the Hive Mind source SHA, version and exact image `konard/hive-mind:<version>`.

The binary, image and serving process are then verified in order, before solve:

1. the binary digest against the receipt;
2. an exact image pull, pinned by `RepoDigest`, whose OCI revision must belong to the selected Hive Mind source;
3. a real `formal-ai serve` in that digest, with `/proc/<pid>/exe` hashed.

A missing artifact ends as `deferred-infrastructure` and a wrong one as `identity-mismatch`; neither falls back to another image or `latest`. Retries keep the identity, and a new source gives a new one. `live-current`, `published-release` and `historical-replay` are labelled separately.

**Hosted attempt (Hive Mind side).** In [run 41547700367](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/41547700367), a `preflight_only` dispatch of the PR branch:

- `select` chose live-current `link-assistant/formal-ai@94e26f09` (0.355.29) via `build`. The `v0.355.29` release was built from the older `658cd102`, so it was not used.
- `binary` built that commit fresh (4m 54s) and verified binary `sha256 8a6bc8ea…`.
- `draft` verified the binary, pulled exactly `konard/hive-mind:2.39.11` and deferred before solve, because that image predates the PR's Hive Mind source.

So an end-to-end live-current draft that passes the image check needs the PR to be merged and released first.

**What this repository's workflow can add.** `hive-mind-draft.yml` keeps working unchanged: running `scripts/formal-ai-draft.mjs` with `FORMAL_AI_DRAFT_BINARY` is admitted as a `caller` attempt bound to that binary's digest. To also bind it to the commit it built, set `FORMAL_AI_DRAFT_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.build.outputs.source_sha }}` on the attempt step. Freshness does not depend on #1486; this attempt built from source without any cache.

title: [Bug][P0] Hive issue-created drafts run stale Formal AI: bind both selected sources to the actual serving runtime
